system.description:
3 Armour Slots. Clang!: you are Resistant to Blunt and Sharp damage. Heavy: your Speed drops one tier while it is equipped. Muscle Enhancer: +1 Talent Point in Grit while you wear it. Bulletproof: you are Resistant to damage from ranged attacks.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.155
